name: 50716-mmlongtext-qwen2vl2b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
architecture: Qwen2VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 2.2B params: a 28-layer language model (hidden 1536, 12 query / 2 KV heads, vocab 151936, max_position_embeddings 32768) plus a 32-layer native-resolution ViT; all shapes are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup 25%, bounded at 400 requests -> 300 measured.
workload: single-turn multimodal chat: one 8000-token synthetic text block followed by two synthetic 1280x720 JPEGs in a single user message, 16 output tokens, greedy (temperature 0), dataset seed 0. The images add ~2,400 feature tokens, so the engine sees ~10,420 prompt tokens against the declared max-model-len of 16384. Driven through guidellm's in-process `vllm_python` backend rather than over HTTP.
purpose: A compact vision-language assistant answering long illustrated documents with two photos per question, four concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# Three keys are set; everything else is the engine default.

model: Qwen/Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 16384
